description.value:
This crescent moon carved out of bone holds the power to turn back the undead. This spellheart covers any item it's affixed to with spiderwebs that reappear even if damaged or removed. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 30.

  • Armor After you cast a vitality spell by Activating the crescent, you gain resistance 10 to attacks and effects from undead creatures until the end of your next turn.

  • Weapon After you cast a vitality spell by Activating the crescent, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[1d8[vitality]] damage until the end of your next turn.
